stem: What was one effect of these events on the 1828 presidential election?

options.label: A
options.text: Votes were cast by secret ballot.

options.label: B
options.text: Property qualifications for voting were strengthened.

visual_elements: Andrew Jackson won the most votes in the Electoral College, but he did not have a majority.
Under the Twelfth Amendment, the decision was turned over to the House of Representatives, which elected John Quincy Adams.
Jackson's supporters called Adams's election the result of a "corrupt bargain."
